channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Helicopter Crash in Zimbabwe Kills Six Aboard
item.description: A helicopter carrying six people crashed in Zimbabwe, resulting in no survivors. Officials confirmed the incident, which claimed the life of Zimbabwean businessman Wicknell Chivayo. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Cocaine worth millions replaced with flour in UK court
item.description: A cocaine shipment valued at £10.4 million has gone missing from a court in the United Kingdom and was allegedly replaced with flour. The discovery was made after a large drug haul was found at a major airport, with an attempt to hide… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Rapper Rick Ross Arrested for Alleged Battery
item.description: Rapper Rick Ross has been arrested and charged with battery following an alleged attack on his girlfriend. The specific charge mentioned is battery by strangulation. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Judge Rules Mosque Leader Can Be Deported
item.description: A U.S. judge has ruled that Salah Sarsour, identified as the leader of Wisconsin's largest mosque, can be deported. The ruling was made by a U.S. judge. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Chinese Hackers Impersonated AI Experts to Target US Policy
item.description: Chinese hackers posed as artificial intelligence experts to target individuals involved in US policy-making, according to reports. The operation involved deception, including the use of lies and betrayal, to gain access and gather… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Helicopter Crash Off California Coast: 4 Rescued, 1 Missing
item.description: A medevac helicopter crashed off Catalina Island, resulting in four people being rescued and one person remaining missing. Four individuals were rushed to the hospital following the incident. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump team probes DOJ for alleged misconduct in Nixon-era Watergate probe
item.description: Donald Trump's legal team is reportedly investigating whether the Department of Justice (DOJ) committed misconduct during its investigation into Richard Nixon's Watergate scandal. The inquiry by Trump's team is examining the historical… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Grenfell fire: Council faces manslaughter charge consideration
item.description: Kensington and Chelsea Council is facing consideration for a corporate manslaughter charge in relation to the Grenfell fire. The Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) has been asked to consider bringing charges against firms and individuals… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Fatal Shooting on Culver CityBus, Suspect at Large
item.description: A fatal shooting occurred on a Culver CityBus, according to a witness. The suspect is currently at large. The incident took place on Central Avenue. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Hezbollah received $157 million in weapons in 2024, report states
item.description: Hezbollah acquired $157 million worth of weapons in 2024, with the majority provided freely by Iran, according to a report. The report states that these weapons were mostly supplied by one nation. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Turkey Detains Three Opposition Mayors on Corruption Allegations
item.description: Turkish authorities have detained three opposition mayors in connection with corruption allegations. The detentions include the mayor of Mersin, who is affiliated with the CHP party. The specific nature of the corruption allegations and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Attackers kill 7 on bus in Syria
item.description: Seven people were killed when attackers opened fire on a small passenger bus in Syria. The incident was reported by the Syrian state news agency. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Family Sues US Government Over Fatal ICE Shooting
item.description: The family of Renee Good has filed a wrongful death lawsuit following her fatal shooting by a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent. The lawsuit names the U.S. government, an ICE officer, and Trump administration officials… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Man City faces charges, potential sanctions over financial rules
item.description: Manchester City faces numerous charges related to alleged breaches of Premier League financial rules. The club could face penalties including fines or expulsion from the league. Separately, Liverpool manager Jurgen Klopp has downplayed… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Five Crew Members Killed in Somalia Tanker Hijacking Retake
item.description: Pirates killed five crew members, including an Indian sailor, aboard a hijacked tanker off the coast of Somalia. Forces from Puntland retook the vessel. The incident occurred in Somali waters. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Immigration Agency Limits High-Speed Chases and Vehicle Stops
item.description: The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has issued new guidance that bans high-speed vehicle chases and sets tighter rules for traffic stops. A memo outlining these steps aims to improve the safety of ICE officers during vehicle… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Captain Stabbed by Copilot on FlyDubai Flight
item.description: An Indian captain of a FlyDubai flight bound for Israel was stabbed by his copilot. The captain was subsequently hailed as a hero. The incident occurred in the cockpit. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Telangana Men Allegedly Recruited for Russian Frontline After Job Promises
item.description: Four men from Telangana, who were seeking civilian employment in Russia, have allegedly been sent to the Russian frontline after being promised jobs. Their families have approached authorities seeking intervention to locate the men and… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court Rules on Unrelied Documents in Trials
item.description: The Supreme Court has ruled that an accused person is entitled to seek the production of prosecution's unrelied documents at an appropriate stage during a trial. This decision settles a dispute regarding the use of such documents in legal… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala High Court allows termination of 30-week pregnancy for rape survivor
item.description: The Kerala High Court has permitted the medical termination of a 30-week pregnancy for a 15-year-old survivor of rape. The court's decision allows the procedure to be carried out on the minor. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Kunal Kamra, Journalist Move SC on Legislative Privileges and Free Speech
item.description: Comedian Kunal Kamra and journalist Seema Chishti have filed petitions in the Supreme Court concerning legislative privileges and free speech. Chishti has sought to intervene in a reference already pending before the apex court regarding… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Bombay HC Discharges Rahul Raj Singh in Pratyusha Banerjee Abetment Case
item.description: The Bombay High Court has discharged Rahul Raj Singh, the ex-boyfriend of television actress Pratyusha Banerjee, from a case of abetment of suicide. The decision comes 10 years after Banerjee's death. The court's ruling means Singh is no… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Explosion at Mangaluru Refinery Kills One, Injures Nine
item.description: An explosion occurred at the MRPL refinery in Mangaluru, resulting in one fatality and nine injuries. A missing labourer was found dead following the incident, which also sparked a fire that has since been brought under control. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: FSSAI Suspends Seven Seas Hospitality License Over Safety Violations
item.description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has suspended the license of Seven Seas Hospitality due to safety violations. The FSSAI took significant action, leading to the suspension of the food license. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Karnataka CM Protests Alleged Electoral Fraud Outside EC Office
item.description: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar staged a protest outside the Chief Electoral Officer's office, demanding an FIR against officials for alleged electoral fraud in the voter list revision process. He stated he would not leave until… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Karnataka finds hospitals marking up drug prices up to 52 times
item.description: Karnataka government officials have discovered that several hospitals are selling high-cost drugs and consumables at markups ranging from 10 to 52 times their original price. The state government has flagged these significant price hikes… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Multiple Road Accidents Kill Motorcyclists Across India
item.description: In Jalandhar Cantt, a road accident occurred when a tipper truck collided with a motorcycle, resulting in the death of one young man and injuries to another. In Surajpur, Madhya Pradesh, a young man from MP died in a road accident… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Amravati Expressway Accident Kills Seven, Injures 19
item.description: A road accident on the Samruddhi Expressway near Amravati, Maharashtra, resulted in the deaths of seven people and injuries to 19 others. The incident occurred when a truck collided with a Bolero pickup van, also referred to as a tempo… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Uttarakhand Police Arrest Gym Owner Mohammad Deepak Amid Assault Allegations
item.description: Uttarakhand Police arrested gym owner Mohammad Deepak on October 1 in Kotdwar following allegations of threats and assault by a businessman. Police stated the arrest was a preventive measure to avoid a breach of peace. The incident… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: CJI Surya Kant Advocates AI and Digitalization in Judiciary
item.description: Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant has called for the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digitalization into the judicial system. He emphasized the need to balance AI-driven transformation with constitutional values… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Flydubai Flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv Experiences Mid-Air Scare
item.description: A Flydubai flight, FZ1073, traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv experienced a significant security scare mid-air on Wednesday. Emergency signals from the aircraft briefly indicated a possible hijacking, leading Israel to scramble fighter jets… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: Eight students drown off Maharashtra's Diveagar beach during picnic
item.description: Eight students from Pune drowned in the Arabian Sea off Diveagar beach in Maharashtra's Raigad district while on a picnic. The students were reportedly from a coaching class. The incident occurred at Diveagar beach, and the students were… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian pilot hailed hero after foiling cockpit attack on Flydubai flight
item.description: Captain Smit Machchhar, an Indian pilot, is being hailed as a hero after he reportedly foiled an attack by his Omani co-pilot on a Flydubai flight. The co-pilot allegedly stabbed Captain Machchhar and attempted to crash the aircraft, which… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 4.

item.title: Pilot Smit Machchhar Praised for Averting Mid-Air Incident
item.description: Captain Smit Machchhar is being widely recognized for his actions during a mid-air incident where he was attacked by an Omani pilot who used his feet to damage the controls. Despite being injured, Captain Machchhar continued to fly the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 4.

item.title: NY Times director shot dead in California, in‑laws arrested
item.description: Jonathan McKinsey, 40, a New York Times engineering director, was shot dead in a car park in Dublin, California; his wife's parents, both 77, were arrested and court records show a custody dispute. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: FBI Adds Goldy Brar to Ten Most Wanted List, Offers $1 Million Reward
item.description: The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has added gangster Goldy Brar to its Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list. The FBI is offering a reward of up to $1 million for information leading to Brar's arrest. Brar is allegedly involved in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Russia Launches Drone and Missile Strikes Across Ukraine
item.description: Russia conducted widespread drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, hitting targets in the capital Kyiv and other regions. In Kyiv, strikes impacted the historic center and a school, with one report indicating the Kyiv Science Academy… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court Takes Suo Motu Notice on Delhi Rape Cases
item.description: The Supreme Court has taken suo motu cognizance of rape incidents involving minors in Delhi, noting "painful similarities" to the Nirbhaya case. The court criticized the police and the system, stating that the current situation brought… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Seeks Report on Delhi Women's Safety
item.description: The Supreme Court has requested a report concerning the safety of women and children in Delhi-NCR. The court's inquiry comes amid concerns that authorities have been lax regarding women's safety in Delhi. One report highlighted the court's… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Elephant Tusks and Blackbuck Seized in Separate Telangana Incidents
item.description: In Hyderabad, the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized four elephant tusks and apprehended three individuals. Separately, in Telangana, nine people were arrested for alleged blackbuck hunting and meat smuggling. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
